summary: Layer 1B expansion found a small set of US-listed direct-exposure companies in global trade compliance software, customs brokerage, tariff analytics, and testing/inspection/compliance services. The cleanest underfollowed exposure is Descartes Systems, which sells customs, regulatory, global trade intelligence, denied-party screening, and tariff-related software. C.H. Robinson and Expeditors are larger logistics/customs-brokerage platforms with direct operational exposure to tariff complexity, while UL Solutions is a public testing, inspection, certification, responsible-sourcing, and supply-chain compliance platform with plausible second-order exposure to forced-labor and origin-verification requirements. No buy/sell view is implied.
